summary: LLM API pricing in late 2026 continues to trend downward, with aggressive competition at the low end (Gemini Flash and GPT-4o mini near $0.10-$0.15 per million input tokens) and premium reasoning models still commanding $10-$75 per million output tokens. Prompt caching discounts (typically 50-90% off cached input) and batch processing discounts (usually ~50%) have become standard cost-reduction levers across all major vendors. The research data confirms stable OpenAI GPT-4o pricing at $2.50 input / $10 output, while most published prices for other vendors are drawn from established, confirmed rate cards.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.notes: Batch API offers ~50% discount. Cached input priced at half the standard input rate. Confirmed via multiple sources at $2.50 in / $10 out.

models.name: GPT-4o mini
models.notes: One of the cheapest capable models; roughly 16x cheaper than GPT-4o. Batch discount ~50%. Comparable performance on summarization/classification tasks.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.notes: Prompt caching reads at ~10% of input cost; cache writes cost more. Batch API offers 50% discount. Mid-tier balance of cost and quality.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.notes: Free tier via Google AI Studio with rate limits. Among the cheapest options per research data (~$0.075-$0.15/M input). Context caching available.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.notes: Tiered pricing: input rises to $2.50 and output to $15 for prompts over 200K tokens. Free tier available in AI Studio with limits.

models.name: o3
models.notes: Reasoning model; output includes reasoning tokens which are billed. Batch discount available. Input price confirmed at $2.00 via research data.

models.name: o4-mini
models.notes: Cost-efficient reasoning model. Reasoning tokens billed as output. Batch API ~50% discount.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.notes: Fast, low-cost tier. Prompt caching reads at ~10% of input. Batch API 50% discount.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.8
models.notes: Premium flagship model for complex reasoning. Highest priced in Anthropic lineup. Batch discount 50%; cache reads ~10% of input cost.

models.name: Grok 4
models.notes: Available via xAI API. Pricing tiers may vary for higher context lengths. Cached input offered at a discount.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B (hosted)
models.notes: Open-weight model hosted on Together AI; pricing varies by provider (Groq and Fireworks offer similar/lower rates). No prompt caching discount standard.

models.name: Mistral Large
models.notes: Free tier available via La Plateforme with rate limits. Batch discounts available on the platform.

models.name: Mistral Small
models.notes: Low-cost model with free tier access via La Plateforme. Strong price/performance for lightweight tasks.

models.name: Command R+
models.notes: Free trial API keys available with rate limits. Strong at RAG and tool use. Production keys billed at standard rates.
